body.name: kappaH
body.def: For \(v\in(0,1)\), fix any \(j\in I\), orientation \(\theta\), and \(a\) with \(a_j=v\), and set \(\kappa_H(v)=\lim_{u\downarrow0}u^{-2}H_{j,-\theta_j}(P_{a,t^{[j]}(u),\theta})\). Along \(t^{[j]}(u)\), every coordinate other than \(j\) is fixed at zero; factorization of \(P_{a,t,\theta}\) makes the displayed coordinate functional independent of the remaining entries of \(a\).
